localFrameTiming.note: Browser RAF wall-clock intervals include real input and screenshots; this is a local hardware observation, not a GPU timing or cross-device guarantee.

idleFrameTiming.note: First 120 sampled frames before mouse input and screenshots.

limitations: Local Chrome on RTX 5070 Ti and high-refresh display; frame IDs prove same-render synchronization, not a universal end-to-end hardware latency or all-device 60FPS guarantee.
65 core/asset tests and affected action suites; not the entire repository browser suite, other browsers, mobile, hosting, or EXE packaging.

The first depth counts were superseded because live video/HTML clock contaminated screenshot comparisons. Final evidence freezes VideoTextures and reads raw GPU pixels within the actual panel ROI with an outside control allowing at most one 8-bit level of quantization noise.
Legacy ornate tests overwrote their historical review output paths; all nine historical PNGs were restored byte-for-byte. Only the 14 new PNGs are appended to the asset manifest.
